Method of Attack: memory corruption bug allowing unprivileged users to gain full root privileges on Linux systems with default configurations
Impacted Systems: Linux systems using Polkit's pkexec component including Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, CentOS
Date of Discovery: May 2009 (origin of bug), publicly disclosed in 2021
Indicators of Compromise: proof-of-concept exploit code shared online less than three hours after Qualys published technical details
Attack Vector: exploitation of Polkit's pkexec component vulnerability
